noSignal: No recent signal found in the sources consulted on this account. That is not a reason to skip it — it is a reason to ask why.
noContact: No contact identified — the first question of the meeting is « who decides? ».
noProof: No usable proof recorded on this account. Quoting one you do not have is the single thing not to do.

proofAbsence.absent: No usable proof for this angle. Collect a case study, or write your own opener — quoting one you do not have is the single thing not to do.
proofAbsence.non_verifiable: The angle put forward a reference none of your declared clients backs, so it was removed. Declare it on your profile if it is true; otherwise lean on something else.
proofAbsence.non_verifie: This angle was produced before proofs were checked. We do not know whether it had one — which is not the same as having none. Re-run the analysis to settle it.

unknownsFallback: No unknowns are recorded on this account — that does not prove there are none. Write down what you do not know before you go.

first_meeting.label: First meeting
questions: Do you work with external providers, and on what scope?
Are needs centralised in procurement, or handled by the teams?
Do you already have referenced partners or IT services firms?
How do you staff peaks today?
Who else would be around the table for a decision?
objections: « We already have partners » → which ones, on what scope?
« Go through procurement » → who really decides the need?
« You are too small » → one scope, not a programme.

client_checkin.label: Client check-in
questions: Where are you on the scope we started together?
What has changed on the team side since our last check-in?
Is there a new need that was not on the table at the start?
objections: « We have not seen the expected results yet » → on which indicator exactly?
« The scope changed on our side » → what moved, and since when?
« We are looking at another solution » → for which need, and what is missing today?

partner.label: Partner
questions: On which accounts do you see the most overlap with our positioning?
How do you qualify an opportunity before passing it to us?
What agreement format works for you — referral, co-staffing, subcontracting?
objections: « We already have partners in this space » → on which scope exactly, and with what exclusivity?
« The volume does not justify a formal agreement » → one shared deal is enough to test it.
« Our teams do not have time to qualify for a third party » → what would make that easier for you?

renewal.label: Renewal
questions: What worked best on the current engagement?
Is there a friction point to address before renewing?
Should the scope evolve for the next period?
objections: « We want to put it back out to tender » → what is driving that, on which point exactly?
« The budget is being cut » → which scope stays the priority?
« We are still waiting on the internal decision » → who is left to convince, and on what?

defense.label: Defense
questions: What are the announced decision criteria, in order?
Who else is in the running, as far as you know?
What would tip the decision our way today?
objections: « A competitor is cheaper » → on which scope exactly, for equal delivery?
« You are less known in this sector » → a verifiable reference outweighs general name recognition.
« The decision is already made » → that is not a reason to skip clarifying what remains open.
